hooks.command:
python3 -c "import json,sys,os,re
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','')
approved=bool(re.search(r'\.sdlc/.+/(intent|spec)\.md$',p)) and os.path.exists(p) and 'status: approved' in open(p).read()
if approved: print('Blocked: this SDLC artifact is approved and immutable. Mark it status: superseded and draft a new one (supersede flow). plan.md stays editable by design.',file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(2 if approved else 0)"
